options.content:
- Use Cases: Enter a Jira issue key to see which pull request(s) it maps to and when each one reached production. Leave the key empty to list every linked issue released in the selected time range.
- Released to Production: first successful PRODUCTION deployment after the PR merged, as computed by the DORA plugin (`project_pr_metrics`). The issue counts as released once its last linked PR is deployed.
- Data Sources Required: Jira, GitHub, a deployment source (Jenkins/ArgoCD/webhook) and DORA enabled on the project. Issue-to-PR links come from `pull_request_issues`; PRs whose title/branch/description does not reference the issue key will not appear.

panels.description: Time the last linked PR reached production. Shows how many PRs are released when some are still pending.

targets.rawSql:
with _pr_release as (
  select
    ppm.id as pr_id,
    min(ppm.pr_deployed_date) as released_date,
    min(ppm.deployment_commit_id) as deployment_commit_id
  from project_pr_metrics ppm
  where ppm.pr_deployed_date is not null
  group by ppm.id
),

_issue_prs as (
  select
    i.issue_key,
    i.url as issue_url,
    i.title as issue_title,
    i.status as issue_status,
    r.name as repo,
    pr.pull_request_key,
    pr.url as pr_url,
    pr.title as pr_title,
    pr.status as pr_status,
    pr.merged_date,
    pr.merge_commit_sha,
    rel.released_date,
    cdc.name as deployment,
    cdc.url as deployment_url
  from issues i
    join pull_request_issues pri on pri.issue_id = i.id
    join pull_requests pr on pr.id = pri.pull_request_id
    left join repos r on r.id = pr.base_repo_id
    left join _pr_release rel on rel.pr_id = pr.id
    left join cicd_deployment_commits cdc on cdc.id = rel.deployment_commit_id
  where
    i.id like 'jira:%'
    and (
      ('${issue_key}' != '' and i.issue_key = upper(trim('${issue_key}')))
      or ('${issue_key}' = '' and $__timeFilter(rel.released_date))
    )
)

select
  case
    when '${issue_key}' = '' then 'Enter an issue key'
    when count(*) = 0 then 'No linked PRs'
    when sum(merged_date is not null) = 0 then 'No merged PRs yet'
    when sum(merged_date is not null and released_date is null) > 0
      then concat('Not fully released (', sum(released_date is not null), '/', sum(merged_date is not null), ' merged PRs)')
    else date_format(max(released_date), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i UTC')
  end as 'Released'
from _issue_prs

panels.title: Released [${issue_key}]

panels.description: One row per linked pull request. Empty Released to Production means DevLake has not attributed a production deployment to the PR yet.

targets.rawSql:
with _pr_release as (
  select
    ppm.id as pr_id,
    min(ppm.pr_deployed_date) as released_date,
    min(ppm.deployment_commit_id) as deployment_commit_id
  from project_pr_metrics ppm
  where ppm.pr_deployed_date is not null
  group by ppm.id
),

_issue_prs as (
  select
    i.issue_key,
    i.url as issue_url,
    i.title as issue_title,
    i.status as issue_status,
    r.name as repo,
    pr.pull_request_key,
    pr.url as pr_url,
    pr.title as pr_title,
    pr.status as pr_status,
    pr.merged_date,
    pr.merge_commit_sha,
    rel.released_date,
    cdc.name as deployment,
    cdc.url as deployment_url
  from issues i
    join pull_request_issues pri on pri.issue_id = i.id
    join pull_requests pr on pr.id = pri.pull_request_id
    left join repos r on r.id = pr.base_repo_id
    left join _pr_release rel on rel.pr_id = pr.id
    left join cicd_deployment_commits cdc on cdc.id = rel.deployment_commit_id
  where
    i.id like 'jira:%'
    and (
      ('${issue_key}' != '' and i.issue_key = upper(trim('${issue_key}')))
      or ('${issue_key}' = '' and $__timeFilter(rel.released_date))
    )
)

select
  issue_key as 'Issue',
  issue_url,
  issue_title as 'Issue Title',
  issue_status as 'Issue Status',
  repo as 'Repo',
  concat('#', pull_request_key) as 'PR',
  pr_url,
  pr_title as 'PR Title',
  pr_status as 'PR Status',
  merged_date as 'Merged',
  released_date as 'Released to Production',
  deployment as 'Deployment',
  deployment_url,
  (
    select min(d.finished_date)
    from cicd_deployment_commits d
    where d.commit_sha = _issue_prs.merge_commit_sha
      and d.result = 'SUCCESS'
  ) as 'First Deploy of Merge Commit (any env)'
from _issue_prs
order by released_date is null, released_date desc, merged_date desc
limit 500
